cells: Part XIV – Services Under the Union and States

blocks.content: Constitutional status accords permanence, sanctity, and legal immunity against ordinary legislative overrides.

rows: Derived directly from specific Articles of the Constitution
Created by an Act enacted by Parliament or State Legislature
Can be amended or abolished through ordinary legislation
National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), SEBI, CVC

items: Questions frequently test the distinction between Constitutional Bodies (e.g., ECI, CAG) and Statutory Bodies (e.g., NHRC, NITI Aayog).
Article 243D mandates a minimum of one-third (33%) reservation of seats for women in Panchayats across all levels.
State Election Commission (Article 243K) is an independent constitutional body responsible for conducting local body elections.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Constitutional status accords democratic legitimacy, permanence, and protection from legislative overrides.
The 73rd and 74th Constitutional Amendment Acts of 1992 conferred constitutional status on local self-governing institutions in India.
Constitutional bodies derive their powers directly from the Constitution rather than ordinary statutes.
Any alteration to the structure or tenure of constitutional bodies requires an amendment under Article 368.
